inner_file.name: FY24.xlsx
inner_file.title: SNAP Monthly State Participation and Benefit Summary P-EBT/Other Excluded - Public Data, Fiscal Year 2024

source.semantics: Per-state 'Cost' column = SNAP benefit dollars issued, reported monthly for the 12 federal fiscal-year months Oct 2023 through Sep 2024, organized in FNS region sheets (NERO/MARO/SERO/MWRO/SWRO/MPRO/WRO). Each state's 'Total' row for Cost is the ANNUAL SUM of the 12 monthly values (verified exactly for every jurisdiction; the participation columns' Total row is by contrast a monthly average). Values are dollars, not thousands. Title states P-EBT/Other issuance is excluded. The sum equals the 'Total Benefits' line (not 'Total Costs', which adds admin) of the FNS National Level Annual Summary, confirming the column is benefit issuance.

notes.PR: Puerto Rico appears in the file (MARO sheet) with '--' in all months: PR operates the NAP block grant, not SNAP. Excluded from 'states'.
notes.AS: American Samoa appears with '--' in all months (nutrition-assistance block grant, not SNAP). Excluded.
notes.MP: Northern Mariana Islands appears with '--' in all months (block grant, not SNAP). Excluded.
notes.GU: Guam participates in regular SNAP; FY2024 issuance included.
notes.VI: Virgin Islands participates in regular SNAP; FY2024 issuance included.
notes.file_caveats: File states 'ALL DATA SUBJECT TO REVISION'. Footnote 1 says Total Participation counts exclude Disaster Supplements and Replacements categories (a subset of Regular Ongoing); the file does not state whether the Cost column includes disaster-supplement dollars - UNVERIFIED either way from this file.
